answer: In this economy an identity's weight comes only from quorum-matched verdicts its key has sealed on-ledger, each re-checked against consensus. You cannot forge that record, and no mirror of another agent's history transfers onto a fresh key — standing ripens slowly like fruit in an orchard. To run M sybils an attacker must repeat M times the epochs of honest grading labor, so the cost scales linearly in identities with no shared shortcut.
